grandline.combat.covered: Blocked by cover — get a clear line
grandline.combat.fb.blocked: Blocked — try a heavy blow, or wait for an opening
grandline.combat.fb.intangible: No effect — a Logia: use Armament Haki or seastone
grandline.lesson.strike: Good strike! Hold the attack button for a heavy blow: slower, but it breaks a guard.
grandline.lesson.guard: Good guard! Start guarding just before a blow lands to parry it: no damage, and the attacker staggers.
grandline.lesson.dodge: Good dodge! You are untouchable for an instant; it costs stamina and needs a moment to recover.
grandline.lesson.technique: Technique used! Each has its own cooldown on the bar; scroll or press the next-set key for more.
grandline.spar.start: A training bout! Your partner's blows won't hurt. Strike, guard (Combat Mode, right-click), dodge, and try a technique.
grandline.spar.won: "Well fought!" Your sparring partner bows out.
grandline.spar.not_now: Not now — someone is after you.
grandline.threat.warn.dangerous: ⚠ Dangerous: %s is stronger than you — guard, dodge and use your techniques
grandline.threat.warn.overwhelming: ⚠ Overwhelming: %s is far beyond you — retreat unless you are well prepared
screen.grandline.controls.loop.1: 1. Close in and pick a target (look at it, or lock on).
screen.grandline.controls.loop.2: 2. Strike: tap for quick blows, hold for a heavy one.
screen.grandline.controls.loop.3: 3. Watch the foe: a red flash or a gold ring means something big is coming.
screen.grandline.controls.loop.4: 4. Guard (just before it lands = parry) or dodge out of the way.
screen.grandline.controls.loop.5: 5. Hit back while it recovers, and save your techniques for openings.
screen.grandline.controls.tell.heavy: Red flash over the head: a heavy blow in about half a second.
screen.grandline.controls.tell.technique: Gold ring at the feet: a technique is coming.
screen.grandline.controls.tell.boss: Marks on the ground: a boss attack lands there — step out.
screen.grandline.controls.tell.danger: A warning over the hotbar and ▲/▲▲ on the target frame: stronger than you.
hud.grandline.tips.title: Fighting — the basics
hud.grandline.tips.strike: Strike: tap %s · hold for a heavy blow
hud.grandline.tips.guard: Guard: Combat Mode (%s), then hold %s · just before a hit = parry
hud.grandline.tips.tells: Red flash = heavy blow coming · gold ring = technique
hud.grandline.tips.more: All controls: /controls (or the Controls button on the Character screen)
